item.title: macEM 2.1.0
item.description:
macEM 2.1.0 adds a Settings window, particles in a region you draw, Undo for removed marks, spots, rings and EELS references, and marks from the keyboard.
• Images, stacks and EBSD patterns keep their bit depth, so large files open in far less memory. • Bruker, EDAX and EMsoft .h5 orientation maps open in the Maps room. • The website download checks for updates itself. • Damaged files are refused in plain words instead of stopping the app.
Results can differ from 2.0.2: EDS absorption on tilted GMS files, grain sizes on unequal x and y steps, and colour maps.
